probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and __at least one__ member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, __wherein the composite fabric layer is applied after the filler is positioned in the void__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin matrix of the laminated composite tape__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and wherein the fabric layer is bonded to the radius areas via the structural adhesive layer__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix, __and wherein the composite fabric layer is distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape of the members__.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __and wherein the adhesive layer is a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the offset fabric layers are bonded together by the structural adhesive layer__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __wherein the composite fabric layer is applied after the reinforcing member is positioned in the radius filler zone__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin matrix of the composite channels and base__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and wherein each patch is bonded to the respective channel or base via the structural adhesive layer__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin matrix of the composite channels and base__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, __and wherein the adhesive extending beyond the radius filler zone is a structural adhesive applied as a discrete layer__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from laminated composite tape and__ joined together by __a structural adhesive layer applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin matrix of the channels__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape including a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the composite fabric layer is applied after the radius filler zone is defined__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin matrix of the I-section structure__.
